content.title: CPI: Q3 Earnings Snapshot
content.summary: EDGEWOOD, N.Y. (AP) — CPI Aerostructures Inc. CVU) on Thursday reported profit of $1.1 million in its third quarter. On a per-share basis, the Edgewood, New York-based company said it had profit of 9 cents.

content.title: CPI: Q2 Earnings Snapshot
content.summary: EDGEWOOD, N.Y. (AP) — CPI Aerostructures Inc. CVU) on Tuesday reported a loss of $1.3 million in its second quarter. The Edgewood, New York-based company said it had a loss of 10 cents per share.
